pages.title: Bose-Einstein Condensate
pages.text: Thousands of atoms behaving as one. Chilled to within a whisper of absolute zero, they share a single wavefunction and slide as a single wave, rippling with interference fringes. It looks like a faint mist that refuses to scatter.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Seeding superfluid helium with quantum dots in the Bose-Einstein Condenser, I watched the atoms' wave packets swell until they overlapped and fused into one. Matter forgot it was many particles.
